entities.summary: Andrei Eduardovich Kuzmin is a Russian former ice hockey player. He played in the Kontinental Hockey League from 2008 to 2013, while the rest of his career, which lasted from 1998 to 2018, was mainly spent in the lower leagues of Russia.
